title: Naturally Occurring HMGB1 Inhibitor, Glycyrrhizin, Modulates Chronic Seizures-Induced Memory Dysfunction in Zebrafish Model.
authors: Paudel, Yam Nath; Khan, Shafi Ullah; Othman, Iekhsan; Shaikh, Mohd Farooq
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草酸在斑马鱼癫痫模型中通过HMGB1-TLR4轴调节记忆功能障碍，分子对接仅涉及蛋白-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: Glycyrrhizin (GL) is a well-known pharmacological inhibitor of high mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) and is abundantly present in the licorice root (Glycyrrhiza radix). HMGB1 protein, a key mediator of neuroinflammation, has been implicated in several neurological disorders, including epilepsy. Epilepsy is a devastating neurological disorder with no effective disease-modifying treatment strategies yet, suggesting a pressing need for exploring novel therapeutic options. In the current investigation, using a second hit pentylenetetrazol (PTZ) induced chronic seizure model in adult zebrafish, regulated mRNA expression of HMGB1 was inhibited by pretreatment with GL (25, 50, and 100 mg/kg, ip). A molecular docking study suggests that GL establishes different binding interactions with the various amino acid chains of HMGB1 and Toll-like receptor-4 (TLR4). Our finding suggests that GL pretreatment reduces/suppresses second hit PTZ induced seizure, as shown by the reduction in the seizure score. GL also regulates the second hit PTZ induced behavioral impairment and rescued second hit PTZ related memory impairment as demonstrated by an increase in the inflection ratio (IR) at the 3 h and 24 h T-maze trial. GL inhibited seizure-induced neuronal activity as demonstrated by reduced C-fos mRNA expression. GL also modulated mRNA expression of BDNF, CREB-1, and NPY. The possible mechanism underlying the anticonvulsive effect of GL could be attributed to its anti-inflammatory activity, as demonstrated by the downregulated mRNA expression level of HMGB1, TLR4, NF-kB, and TNF-alpha. Overall, our finding suggests that GL exerts an anticonvulsive effect and ameliorates seizure-related memory disruption plausibly through regulating of the HMGB1-TLR4-NF-kB axis.
abstract_zh: 甘草酸 (Glycyrrhizin, GL) 是一种众所周知的高迁移率族蛋白B1 (HMGB1) 药理学抑制剂，广泛存在于甘草根 (Glycyrrhiza radix) 中。HMGB1蛋白是神经炎症的关键介质，已被涉及多种神经系统疾病，包括癫痫。癫痫是一种破坏性神经系统疾病，目前尚无有效的疾病修饰治疗策略，表明迫切需要探索新的治疗选择。在本研究中，使用成年斑马鱼中二次打击戊四唑 (pentylenetetrazol, PTZ) 诱导的慢性癫痫模型，通过GL（25、50和100 mg/kg，腹腔注射）预处理抑制了HMGB1的调控mRNA表达。分子对接研究表明，GL与HMGB1和Toll样受体-4 (TLR4) 的各种氨基酸链建立了不同的结合相互作用。我们的发现表明，GL预处理减少/抑制了二次打击PTZ诱导的癫痫发作，如癫痫评分降低所示。GL还调节了二次打击PTZ诱导的行为损伤，并通过在3小时和24小时T迷宫试验中增加拐点比 (inflection ratio, IR) 挽救了二次打击PTZ相关的记忆损伤。GL抑制了癫痫诱导的神经元活动，如C-fos mRNA表达减少所示。GL还调节了BDNF、CREB-1和NPY的mRNA表达。GL抗惊厥作用的潜在机制可能归因于其抗炎活性，如HMGB1、TLR4、NF-kB和TNF-alpha的mRNA表达水平下调所示。总体而言，我们的发现表明，GL发挥抗惊厥作用并改善癫痫相关的记忆破坏，可能通过调节HMGB1-TLR4-NF-kB轴实现。
